"A medium-sized speaker system designed around an edgeless woofer based on the SLE system.A 20cm cone type woofer using SLE method is mounted in the low range.In the SLE (Super Linear Long Excursion) system, the mechanical suspension (edge) is removed from the outer circumference of the cone paper, and excellent linearity is obtained. In addition, a balanced double damper mechanism is adopted in which two upper and lower positions of the winding part of the voice coil are fixed, and the symmetry of the piston motion of the cone paper is enhanced.In the SLE woofer, by eliminating the edge and adopting a double damper mechanism, the stroke of the vibration system is twice that of the conventional one, thereby realizing excellent input resistance despite the 20cm aperture.The SLE system woofer unit is equipped with an acoustic low-pass filter.There is a gap of 1mm between the cone paper and the outer ring frame. If this part is replaced with an equivalent circuit, it works like a port in a bass-reflex cabinet with a resonance point at a certain frequency. The acoustic low-pass filter is designed so that the resonance frequency is below the audible frequency. Therefore, this filter has a sufficiently large attenuation characteristic in the audible frequency, the gap can be completely ignored, the sound pressure before and after the cone paper does not short-circuit through the gap, and there is no sound pressure drop.The cone paper of Woofer is made of pulp material with sufficient rigidity, and special material with large internal loss is added for composite molding, which increases internal loss while maintaining rigidity.The mid-range is equipped with a 10cm cone scoker and the high-range is equipped with a 5cm cone tweeter.The diaphragm of these units is a composite molding cone combined with a dome radiator.The enclosure is hermetically sealed.The exterior has a Eurasian cheek open pore finish."

"An active speaker system that pursues the concept of total monitoring by equipping the NF-1with an amplifier.The amplifier section has a simple circuit structure to achieve low distortion and low noise.
